description: This PHP file is part of the SuiteCRM project and appears to manage the generation of a list of upgrade-related files for the UpgradeWizard module, including dynamic detection and fallback to a default list. It handles file discovery, version-specific adjustments, and defines an array of files that are involved in the upgrade process.

methods.name: findAllFiles
methods.description: Recursively finds all files in a given directory matching certain criteria.

methods.name: clean_path
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a file path.
